result.description: Compact desktop audio interface for creators and streamers, featuring dual low-noise microphone preamps, 24-bit/192 kHz conversion, a dedicated headphone output, and bus-powered operation over Thunderbolt 3. Designed for podcast capture, voiceover work, and mobile studio setups, it includes loopback mixing, direct monitor control, and a matte graphite aluminum chassis.
